tools.name: get_listing_policies
tools.description: Every policy fact for ONE listing in one call: check-in/out times, advance notice, preparation days, this month's minimum stay, cancellation policy, and (when configured) amendment rules like late checkout. Use for ANY rules/policy question about a home.

tools.name: get_faq_answer
tools.description: Retrieve the host's own Q&A entries most relevant to a factual question about the stay, the house, or the host's services. Prefer this over guessing for any host-specific question.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search available vacation rentals across Greece. Pass explicit destinations, dates, guest counts and filters as structured fields; use query only for preferences not represented by another field. Do not invent locations, dates, guest counts or budgets the guest never gave. Results include stable listing ids for follow-up calls (get_listing_details, check_availability_and_price).

query.description: optional free-text preferences NOT captured by the structured filters, e.g. 'quiet romantic vibe with sunset views' — do not repeat structured information here

location.description: a PLACE the guest actually named: city, island, region, island complex ('Cyclades') or area ('Athens south coast'). For generic geography ('the islands', 'the mountains', 'by the sea') use setting instead — do NOT guess a region the guest never said. Omit if unknown

setting.description: geography facet for generic wishes: 'στα νησιά'/'the islands' → island; combinable with budget/dates, replaces a location guess

mood.description: holiday-mood collection: beach=steps from the sea/coves, pools=private pool/resort calm, sunset=golden-hour terraces/romance, night=chora/town stays with evening life

guests.description: total guests (alternative to adults/children when the split is unknown)

children.description: number of children — counted toward capacity together with adults

infants.description: number of infants — noted but NOT counted toward sleeping capacity

amenities.description: hard amenity requirements the guest explicitly asked for — every listed amenity must be present

max_total_price.description: maximum total stay price (EUR) when the guest gave a whole-trip budget — only applied when exact dates are also given (otherwise ignored with a note)

checkin.description: exact arrival date YYYY-MM-DD — ONLY when the guest gave real stay dates. If they only named a month/season ('in August'), leave dates out: availability is checked per night, so a whole month demands 30 free nights

checkout.description: exact departure date YYYY-MM-DD — same rule as checkin

near_metro.description: true only when the guest wants to be near a metro/subway station (Athens & Thessaloniki only) — filters to homes within a 1 km walk of a station

tools.name: get_listing_details
tools.description: Full facts for ONE listing already in play (amenities, description, capacity, base price).

tools.name: check_availability_and_price
tools.description: Exact availability + total price for one listing and concrete dates, with the direct booking link.

checkin.description: YYYY-MM-DD — never in the past; bare day numbers in a follow-up ('26 to 29') keep the month/year already under discussion, NOT the current month
